bagPolicy.summary: No backpacks or large bags are allowed. The venue lists no size limit, and all purses and bags are searched.

parking.summary: Public parking near the venue is limited. If you drive, there is street parking and some privately owned paid lots nearby, which the venue doesn't own and where towing is strictly enforced. Uber or Lyft is recommended, with a designated pickup and drop-off spot near the entrance.

rideshare.summary: Use the designated rideshare pickup and drop-off area near the venue entrance.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says alcoholic beverages are available for purchase at events. Purchasers must be 21 or older and show valid identification.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The entire main floor is ADA accessible and you can bring a mobility device. Limited ADA seating is first come, first served and needs no special ticket; tell staff when you arrive.

reEntry.summary: Official venue guidance states that guests may not re-enter after leaving the venue.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides box-office information and lists hours of 10am - 4pm.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Door and start times are listed on your ticket and on the show's purchase page. Set times vary, usually aren't announced until the day of the show, and can change without notice.
